title: The clan war begins
changes: Five clans now fight over the monster zones of both acts. The fronts move every 10 minutes, day and night, even while you are away.
In a contested zone, a plaque at the top of the screen shows who holds it, how firm their grip is, and when a siege is coming.
The Herald announces sieges and conquests in the chat. Villages, dungeons and the open countryside stay out of the war.
